key_semantics.numbered_form: 1–9 select immediately, multi toggles immediately; >9 uses fresh highlighted row arrows then Enter
key_semantics.permission: Left/Right or h/l wrap; Enter replies selected; full-TUI Always allow saves project permission patterns immediately; no mini-mode always confirmation assumed
key_semantics.permission_reject: Main-session reject replies immediately; child-session reject opens reason textbox. Expanded Escape minimizes first. Rejection button keys always navigate exact fresh selection
key_semantics.picker: Up/Down wrap; PageUp/PageDown move 10; Home/End select absolute ends; Enter invokes native selected option; ● configured value is not focus; visible footer shortcuts may be remapped
key_semantics.text_clear: Single-line DialogPrompt/Input Ctrl+a=home and Ctrl+k=delete-to-end; Form/Reject prompt.clear/app.exit Ctrl+c only when nonempty clears entire editor; empty Ctrl+c would dismiss, so never emitted then
key_semantics.form_navigation: Tab moves next field, Left previous field only outside text edit; current field native validation, conditional future fields and final Review remain native
key_semantics.workspace_confirm: Dedicated left/right clamps no/yes; generic DialogConfirm arrows toggle, so SGR focus required
